search_text: published ZDI-07-063 ZDI-CAN-150 RealPlayer RA Field Size File Processing Heap Overflow Vulnerability 2007-10-31 CVE-2007-2264 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2007-2264 ['RealNetworks'] ['RealPlayer'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute code on vulnerable installations of RealPlayer. User interaction is required in that a user must open a malicious .ra/.ram file or visit a malicious web site. The specific flaw exists during the parsing of files with improperly defined size field in the RA header. Specifying a large unsigned value data can trigger a heap corruption and further result in arbitrary code execution under the context of the logged in user. RealNetworks has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
